texts:
Open the Agent Spotlight, type the job you need done, and the agent that does it is standing there in 3D with a write-up of what it is for: three.ws/spotlight

The agents index lists thousands of rows. The Spotlight is the other thing: 15 agents so far, each one a pitch attached to a live agent, never a copy of it. Rename the agent or swap its avatar and the card updates with it.

Search reads the headline, the one-liner, the write-up and the agent's own description, so a plain word finds the agent built for it.

The write-ups we wrote ourselves carry a Curated badge, so a visitor is never told a builder said something they did not write. The builder's own write-up replaces ours the moment they submit one.

One upvote per account per entry, and trending decays by the day, so a new entry is seen before it is buried under what was already popular.

Open any one of them, talk to it, fork it, or put your own in front of everybody. Showcase your agent takes a public agent you own, a headline and a one-liner, and the entry is live on its own page with the agent in 3D.
